choices.B: Only at the midpoint of the interval
choices.C: At endpoints, or at vertices or local extrema inside the interval

question: Where can a continuous function on a closed interval attain its maximum or minimum?
solution: A continuous function on a closed interval attains both a maximum and a minimum. An attaining point is either an endpoint or an interior point. An interior global extremum is also a local extremum, because its value is at least as large as, or at most as large as, all nearby values. Thus C describes the possibilities for a general continuous function.
